title: Welcome To Hanoi
events: Hospitality desk (location to be confirmed). Please bring your passport, visas for Vietnam and Cambodia, your guest form and menu options.
Welcome Reception (location to be confirmed).
Welcome Dinner at Le Beaulieu Restaurant.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Hanoi Sightseeing - Water Puppets
events: Breakfast is served at Spice Garden, Le Club Bar or on the 7th floor.

Departure for a 45-minute ride through the old city on Club cars. Return to the hotel for a quick break before leaving by coach for the Presidential Palace, Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum, Hanoi Hilton and One Pillar Pagoda.
Lunch at Ly Club restaurant.
Approximate arrival at Hotel.
Depart from the lobby for the Water Puppet performance.
Return to hotel. Dinner is not included tonight. Drinks and food are served on the 7th floor until 19:00.
Checked luggage pick up OUTSIDE your room.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Hanoi To Danang And The Rainforests
events: Early Breakfast opening in Spice Garden restaurant.
Depart for the airport. Vietnam Airlines to Danang VN163/8:05-9:30.
Enjoy a two-hour drive to Hue and visit Emperor Tu Duc Mausoleum.
Arrive at La Residence Hotel & Spa, Hue for check in and lunch à la carte.
Depart on Cyclos to Hue citadel / Imperial city and Purple Forbidden City.
Return to hotel. Dinner at Le Parfum restaurant starting at 18:30.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Hue - Da Nang
events: Breakfast opens at Le Parfum restaurant.
Checked luggage OUTSIDE your room ready for pick up.
Depart hotel to visit Thien Mu Pagoda followed by Perfume River cruise.
Drive along Highway 1 to the Vedana Lagoon Resort.
Lunch at Horizon restaurant.
Drive to Danang.
Arrival at Furama Resort. Located on China Beach.
PM
Dinner is included tonight in any of the Furama’s fine restaurants: Café Indochine, Don Cipriani’s or the Steak House.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Farming Village And Hoi An, Unesco Site
events: Breakfast opens at Cafe Indochine.
Depart for a visit to a local farming village followed by a drive to Hoi An.
Ride to the UNESCO World Heritage Site on Cyclos.
Free time to explore the town. Lunch on your own.
Departure back to Furama hotel. You can also choose to come back later. I will arrange it for you.
DINNER
Dinner at your choice of restaurant: Café Indochine, Don Cipriani or the Steak House.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Saigon - Cu Chi Tunnels
events: Breakfast opens at Cafe Indochine.
Luggage pick up OUTSIDE the room.
Depart the hotel for Danang Airport.
Flight departure for Saigon: VN113/9:55-11:30.
Departure from the airport for a 90-minute drive towards the Cu Chi Tunnels. Boxed lunch will be served during the travel.
Tour of the Tunnels. An approximately two-hour tour.
Arrive at Park Hyatt Saigon.
PM
Dinner tonight is included at Square One Restaurant.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Saigon City Tour And Vespa Tour At Night
events: Breakfast opens in Café Opera.
Departure for the Saigon city tour, including Ben Thanh market, the Presidential Palace, and the Eiffel-inspired Post Office.
Lunch at Café Opera in the hotel. Free time for the rest of the afternoon.
Meet at the mezzanine for the Saigon by VESPA tour.
Estimated return to the Hotel, or later if you decide to have a little extra fun!
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Siem Reap, Cambodia
events: Breakfast opens at Cafe Opera.
Luggage pick up from INSIDE the rooms.
Depart for the airport.
Flight departure to Siem Reap: K6 825 13:00/14:20.
Clearing Cambodia immigration and customs on arrival.
Afternoon tour to Ta Prohm temple, Ancient city of Angkor Thom and Bayon temple.
Arrival at Raffles Grand Hotel.
Dinner and Cambodian dance performance at Apsara restaurant.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Sunrise At Angkor Wat & Tonle Sap Lake
intro: Conservative dress code all day today, shorts are fine as long as they cover your knees.
events: Coffee, tea and cookies will be served in the lobby area.
Departure to Angkor Wat.
Return to hotel for Breakfast.
Departure to Tonle Sap Lake. A private boat tour.
Lunch at Sokkhak River Side restaurant in Siem Reap town. Free afternoon.
Return to hotel.
PM
Included à la carte dinner at Cafe D’Angkor or the 1932.
note: Conservative dress code all day today, shorts are fine as long as they cover your knees. Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Siem Reap To Bangkok To Chiang Mai
events: Checked luggage OUTSIDE rooms for pick up.
Breakfast opens at Cafe D’Angkor.
Depart for the airport, around a 45-minute ride.
Flight departure for Bangkok: TG1589 9:50/10:55.
Arrival at Bangkok’s Suvarnabhumi international airport. We will clear Thai immigration here. Remember to have your passport, Thai QR code and both boarding passes.
Flight departure for Chiang Mai: TG110 13:25/14:40.
On arrival in Chiang Mai, follow signage for International Baggage Claim; we will clear Thai Customs here. Tour the Old Walled City of Chiang Mai before going to the hotel.
Arrive at Intercontinental, our home for the next three nights.
Thai Welcome Dinner and traditional show.
EVENING
The itinerary notes that we are here on the last day of the Chiang Mai candle and lantern festival, known primarily as Yi Peng and celebrated alongside Loy Krathong.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Kanta Elephant Sanctuary - Hill Tribe Village
events: Breakfast opens at The Gad Lanna Terrace.
Depart for Kanta elephant sanctuary. Dress casually. We will have the opportunity to bathe with the elephants.
Lunch is catered by the Intercontinental at the elephant sanctuary.

After lunch, visit the Mae Rim Hill Tribe Village. See the Long Neck Karen tribe with their brass neck rings. Some Thai Baht might be useful if you’re interested in some homemade handicrafts. No US cash or cards accepted.
Return to hotel and rest of the day at leisure.
PM
Dinner included at your restaurant choice: The Gad Lanna (Northern Thai cuisine) and HONG’s Chinese Restaurant.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Doi Suthep Buddhist Temple
events: Breakfast opens at The Gad Lanna Terrace.
Depart for a visit to DOI SUTHEP temple.
Return to hotel and rest of the day at leisure. Lunch today is not included.
DINNER
Dinner at hotel at your restaurant choice. Enjoy our last night in Chiang Mai!
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Bangkok - Krung Thep - City Of Angels
events: Checked luggage OUTSIDE rooms for pick up.
Breakfast opens.
Depart for Airport. Bangkok Airways: 10:10. Arriving in Bangkok at 11:35.
Included lunch on arrival at Rosewood Hotel.
Depart by Skytrain. Bangkok’s SKYTRAIN (BTS) connects the whole city by an overhead rail line.
Return to hotel.
PM
Dinner is included at Nan Bei restaurant on the 19th floor of our Hotel. You will make your table and time reservation during lunch.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Klongs Of Old Bangkok & Temple Of Dawn
events: Breakfast opens at Lakorn restaurant.
Depart to River City on the Chao Phraya River for boat tour.
Cross the river and visit Bangkok’s iconic Wat Arun (the Temple of Dawn).
Transfer to our special canal boat for a fascinating tour through the canals (Klongs) of Old Bangkok, known as the Venice of the East.
Included lunch at famous Sorndaeng restaurant (Michelin Star).
Return to Rosewood hotel and rest of the day at leisure.
DINNER
Dinner tonight is not included, see suggestions sheet.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Reclining Buddha - Emerald Buddha / Palace
events: Breakfast opens on 7th floor.
Depart for the highlight temples of Bangkok.
Visit the temple of the Emerald Buddha and the Grand Palace.
A police-escorted Tuk Tuk ride through the streets of Bangkok.
Visit to Wat Po, famous temple of the Reclining Buddha.
Return to hotel and rest of the day at leisure.
Farewell cocktail reception at Lennon’s Bar on 30th floor.
Farewell dinner at Pavilion room, on 5th floor. Time to say see you soon, not good-bye!
note: BRING COMMENT CARDS Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Safe Travel Home! See You Soon, I Hope !
events: Safe travel home! See you soon, I hope!
note: Times and activities as provided in the supplied itinerary; subject to change.
